summary: Twelve-year-old girl on a Telluride-based middle-school backpacking trip left camp near sunset to watch the sunset from a ridge below North Twilight Peak and could not find her way back; overnighted where she stopped; found cold but safe the next morning just beyond Crater Lake by a search party and flown home by helicopter.
location: below North Twilight Peak near Crater Lake (search staged from Andrews Lake parking lot)
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue; San Juan County SAR; CareFlight helicopter
notes: Date approximate (month-level per the Telegraph: search morning in June 2015, 'summer solstice' phrasing). La Plata County SAR led the search with San Juan County SAR mutual aid; camp at ~12,000 ft, nighttime lows in the 30s; girl stayed put once lost.
